title: Group of Young Adults Outdoors by Rustic Cabin, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A group of eleven young men and women gather outdoors on a wooden deck or porch outside a rustic cabin in a wooded setting on a bright sunny day. They are dressed in casual mid-20th-century workwear and leisure attire, including cuffed jeans, headscarves, caps, and button-down shirts. A metal drum with a wooden box on top stands to the left side of the platform.
